findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: app_store_funnel, to_do, app_store_reviews · Private data: connect_account, meta_diagnose, attribution_setup, verify_domain, list_domains, ai_referrals_setup · Public sink: app_performance, briefing, ai_referrals_setup · Destructive: app_map_sources, briefing, site_guides, organic_todo, app_store_keywords, launch_ai_answers, ai_visibility_run_now, ai_visibility_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: app_store_funnel, to_do, app_store_reviews · Private data: connect_account, meta_diagnose, attribution_setup, verify_domain, list_domains, ai_referrals_setup · Public sink: app_performance, briefing, ai_referrals_setup · Destructive: app_map_sources, briefing, site_guides, organic_todo, app_store_keywords, launch_ai_answers, ai_visibility_run_now, ai_visibility_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
